extras.notes: rigged man (Meshy auto-rig with 24 humanoid bones, plus 30 finger bones added in Blender, 54 bones in total, relaxed hand pose) with two animation clips: walk, run

origin.detail: Base mesh and textures generated with an AI image-to-3D tool (Meshy), then cleaned up, scaled, textured and checked in Blender. Skeleton, skinning and the walk and run clips were added automatically with Meshy Auto-Rig. Finger bones and a relaxed hand pose were added in Blender.
